english.note: Use this for a roughly cube-shaped solid object or block rather than the exact geometric shape.
This is the all-purpose noun for a substantial cuboid or block-shaped solid piece.

examples.english: This cube of chocolate is too big; I can't finish it.
examples.traditional: 呢舊方塊朱古力太大粒喇，我食唔晒。
